observations: body L11: «Aetkiopiam» is printed for Aethiopiam; kept as printed.
body L13: the five points stand for the corrupt words of the manuscripts (note 3), as printed.
body L25: a slanting stroke stands over the comma after «proveniat»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L5: the dots of the first letter of «قمير» did not print.
notes_right L20: «ڤلمبڠ» is printed in the Malay spelling of Palembang, its first and last letters with three dots (pa and nga).

notes_left L5-L11: Nallino's addenda et emendanda in Part II (p. XXIII), recorded on p. 169 (L33), note that Fakhr ad-dīn ar-Rāzī rightly calls the gulf that runs into the far end of India the Green Gulf, al-khalīǵ al-akhḍar, as this note conjectures for al-Kharaqī.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
